text:
The fault is in **R1**. The vin1 path gain is set by Rf/R1, and R1 = 6626 Ω gives -1000/6626 ≈ -0.151 V/V, about 20× the -0.0072 target. Scaling R1 to roughly 132.5 kΩ would bring the gain to about -0.0075, inside the spec window. The sensitivity data agrees: a1 moves -16.6% for a +20% change in R1, which matches gain ∝ 1/R1.

Rf is unlikely to be the fault, because a2 = -Rf/R2 ≈ -0.00242 V/V is in spec. M5 being in triode is a real anomaly, but the other specs (offset, bandwidth, power, a2) pass, so it doesn't explain the single failing metric.
